name: IDocumentInspector
description: Represents the interface through which the methods of an IDocumentInspector object are accessed.
remarks: IDocumentInspector provides access to the Fix, GetInfo, and Inspect methods. The IDocumentInspector object is used with custom Document Inspector modules. This is in contrast to modules that are shipped with Microsoft Office.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.signature: GetInfo(Name As String, Desc As String)
methods.description: Gets information about a custom Document Inspector module.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Represents the name of the module.

parameters.name: Desc
parameters.description: Represents the description of the module.

methods.name: Inspect
methods.signature: Inspect(Doc As Object, Status As MsoDocInspectorStatus, Result As String, Action As String)
methods.description: Inspects a document for specific information items or document properties by using a custom Document Inspector module.

parameters.name: Doc
parameters.description: An object representing the container document.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: An enumeration that represents the results of the inspection.

parameters.name: Result
parameters.description: Contains a list of the information items or document properties found in the document.

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Indicates to the user what action to take based on the results of the inspection.

methods.name: Fix
methods.signature: Fix(Doc As Object, hwnd As Long, Status As MsoDocInspectorStatus, Result As String)
methods.description: Performs some action on specific information items or document properties by using a custom Document Inspector module.

parameters.name: Doc
parameters.description: An object representing the container object.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the active document window.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: An enumeration that indicates the status of the action.

parameters.name: Result
parameters.description: Contains the results of the action.
